title: Everyone quoted the wrong DeepSeek price #shorts
description:
Everyone quoted $0.14 per million tokens. The number that matters is $0.0028 — same model, same request, same day. Fifty times apart.

Which one you pay depends on whether your prompt prefix stays identical. That's your decision, not DeepSeek's.

Full breakdown on the channel.

Source: https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing
